# local

Declare a lexically scoped Lua value.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `lua.keyword.local` |
| Origin | Lua base |
| Category | Lua Base |
| Family | Keyword |
| Monaco kind | `keyword` |
| Format | `local <name> [= <value>]` |
| Valid contexts | `file`, `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `local name = value` |

## Example

```lua
local name = value
```
